greeting: Good morning, Zae. Sail-away Sunday in Tampa: Paradise leaves around 3:30 PM, your boarding window is group C02 about 11:00 to 11:30 AM, and the Skyway is waiting on the way out.

calendar.note: Embarkation day: cash or ATM if needed, Waymo or rideshare to Terminal 3, then board Paradise

Carnival Paradise boarding window: group C02, arrive Terminal 3 (815 Channelside Dr) about 11:00 to 11:30 AM with boarding pass and ID.
Afternoon Supplements (10/10 Plan) if still ashore: L-Tyrosine and one or two Omega soft gels.
Scheduled sail-away from Port Tampa Bay; Skyway Bridge on the way out. Sunset about 5:45 PM ET.
Night Supplements (10/10 Plan) once settled in the cabin: L-Theanine and three Neuro-Mag capsules. Creatine 5g any time today.

projectMove.title: Get to Terminal 3 for C02; Arena stays parked
projectMove.body: Today is embarkation only. Waymo reaches Channelside; Tesla Robotaxi does not. Aim for Terminal 3 with boarding pass and ID in your C02 window. Arena Phase 25 is on Grok Build after the weekly quota reset Monday evening about 8:26 PM ET; Testarossa stays silent until then.

tip.title: Blue drop-off at Terminal 3, then Sparkman Wharf if you are early
tip.body: Port Tampa Bay uses the blue route for passenger drop-off at Terminal 3 (815 Channelside Drive). If you land early, Shortwave Coffee at Sparkman Wharf opens at 7 AM a short walk away. Keep passport or ID, Carnival boarding PDF for group C02, and the one sealed 750 ml wine (if packed) ready for security.

extras.cruiseNote: Sail-away day. Boarding group C02 around 11:00 to 11:30 AM at Terminal 3, scheduled departure about 3:30 PM. Cozumel on November 3 is the one shore day. Express Debark setup runs November 4; return bus morning is November 5.
extras.weatherNote: Tampa: low near 70F, high near 82F, with a 69% chance of showers building from mid-afternoon. Sunset 5:45 PM with twilight until about 6:10 PM. Clocks fell back at 2 AM, so today is a 25-hour day.

surprise.title: On your way out of Tampa Bay, the ship slips under the Sunshine Skyway
surprise.body: After Carnival Paradise leaves Port Tampa Bay this afternoon (scheduled around 3:30 PM), the route to the Gulf passes beneath the Sunshine Skyway Bridge, the cable-stayed span with 42 yellow steel cables that opened in 1987. Its ship channel clearance is about 180 feet, which is exactly why Tampa only gets ships built to fit under it: newer giants like the Oasis class stand around 236 feet tall and could never make it in. Sunset in Tampa is at 5:45 PM, with twilight until about 6:10, though the forecast shows clouds and showers building from mid-afternoon, so the view may come with a little drama. One more gift: clocks fell back an hour at 2 AM, so today is a 25-hour day. Bon voyage, Zae.
